content.body:
The Mini-map can be very useful in combat. It displays friendly units on a mission with the same target, mission target, waypoints, enemy contact reports and other important information. It is always centered on you. To zoom in or out of the mini-map, use {map zoom in} and {map zoom out}.
The bottom of the mini-map shows your Latitude and Longitude in the game world and the name of the closest City.
content.title: The Minimap
